shortDescription: Get information from Helm package deployed inside the cluster

options.name: api_key
options.description: Token used to authenticate with the API. Can also be specified via C(K8S_AUTH_API_KEY) environment variable.

options.name: binary_path
options.description: The path of a helm binary to use.

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: Path to a CA certificate used to authenticate with the API. The full certificate chain must be provided to avoid certificate validation errors. Can also be specified via C(K8S_AUTH_SSL_CA_CERT) environment variable.

options.name: context
options.description: Helm option to specify which kubeconfig context to use. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(K8S_AUTH_CONTEXT) will be used instead.

options.name: get_all_values
options.description: Set to C(True) if you want to get all (computed) values of the release. When C(False) (default), only user supplied values are returned.

options.name: host
options.description: Provide a URL for accessing the API. Can also be specified via C(K8S_AUTH_HOST) environment variable.

options.name: kubeconfig
options.description: Helm option to specify kubeconfig path to use. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(K8S_AUTH_KUBECONFIG) will be used instead. The configuration can be provided as dictionary. Added in version 2.4.0.

options.name: release_namespace
options.description: Kubernetes namespace where the chart should be installed.

options.name: release_state
options.description: Show releases as per their states. Default value is C(deployed) and C(failed). If set to C(all), show all releases without any filter applied. If set to C(deployed), show deployed releases. If set to C(failed), show failed releases. If set to C(pending), show pending releases. If set to C(superseded), show superseded releases. If set to C(uninstalled), show uninstalled releases, if C(helm uninstall --keep-history) was used. If set to C(uninstalling), show releases that are currently being uninst

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to verify the API server's SSL certificates. Can also be specified via C(K8S_AUTH_VERIFY_SSL) environment variable.
